title: Wingy, Don Irwin's band and Louisiana musicians
summary: Manno recalls managing the Don Irwin band in Baton Rouge when the leader vanished, and Wingy helping; he lists Gonsolin and Rome Landry as Opelousas and Lafayette men, and says his jazz work was in Texas.
